newsitem.title: USA: At least 3 die in crash of Fine Air cargo plane.
newsitem.headline: At least 3 die in crash of Fine Air cargo plane.

text.p: At least three people were killed in the crash of a Fine Air DC-8 near Miami International Airport Thursday, authorities said.
"There are three dead," said Metro Dade Police spokesman Dennis Morales.
Authorities initially had said there were four crew members on the plane.
"We do not know if they (the dead) were on the plane or on the ground," Dade County Mayor Alex Penelas said.
Police also said at least two people had been injured on the ground when the plane crashed into a busy commercial district, sending flaming wreckage over a wide area.
Fire crews were still putting out fires and combing the smouldering wreckage, which set fire to cars at the crash site.
